page.layout: One column of running text, set in the centre of the page. Nothing in the margins. A rule at the top and faint digitiser text at the bottom right are not printed text.

main_text.p: & Græcis subnixas, ita relinquere non potui, quin semper aliquid de subscisivo tempore illis tribuerem. Ex quo quoque hæ qualescunque animadversiones, quas in subsidium memoriæ adnotavi, ne fugitiva oblivio eas mihi subduceret, & quæ nunc in publicum egrediuntur suum ortum habent. Nec profecto ullum fore credo, qui ad talia transcendere illicitum putet mihi aut aliis, quos suus ordo locusque in aliis muniis detinet. Homo Musarum sacris initiatus, non est (ut ait Cæcilius) unius operis remex & baiulus, generosa mens ad unius res miscellam scientiam non adstringitur, neque alligatur: semper sese versat illa, concutitque, quicquid pulchrum & scitu dignum videt, id omne scit esse suum. Divinæ virgines musæ adstant ubique, & omnes ad se invitant, neminem illæ aversantur qui bonam spem non curavit. Iubent omnes exsurgere, animos sumere, & se quoque hone-

page.notes: The page is a single column with no page number, running head or catchword. Small pen-like marks in the right margin are not printed text and are left out. The final word is broken at the line end as "hone-" with its printed hyphen. "ciuravit" was printed with a u for the vowel and is given as "curavit" under the u/v rule; the word may be a printing error for another verb and should be checked against the scan.
